Income Before Extraordinary Items shifted from -223 to 812, which represents a significant swing to a positive number. Net Income transitioned from -148 to 287. The company demonstrates progress in key areas like revenue and profitability. However, the growing liabilities and increasing cost of goods sold are red flags. A score of 0.3 reflects the positive trend toward profitability but acknowledges the concerns regarding liabilities and cost management.
